definition: Interventions compare the same Best checkpoint. Held-out patient labels are used only in evaluation and relation-score diagnostics. Training relations and objectives remain outer-train only.
relation_scorer_auc: Actual trained DARG RelationEncoder and RelationScorer outputs. AUC is split into original effective graph support and outside-support diagnostic pairs.
positive_negative_graph_message_definiti: Fixed-checkpoint GCN counterfactual differences after applying positive-only and negative-only signed adjacency deltas. Values are diagnostic and need not add because adjacency normalization changes with the edge set.

positive_negative_propagation.decomposition_definition: Fixed-checkpoint counterfactual GCN differences on positive-only and negative-only signed adjacency deltas. These are diagnostics and are not assumed additive after graph normalization.
